arxiv_antecedent.title: Implementing and reasoning about hash-consed data structures in Coq
arxiv_antecedent.scope_read: Section5.1; Figures3–5; mk_and_correct near PDF page14.
arxiv_antecedent.result_and_assumptions: The pure Coq state uses graph/hmap and a fresh-ID counter. Its incr relation preserves existing successful graph lookups and monotonically grows the counter. wf_hashcons includes graph/hmap correspondence, fresh IDs and well-formed children; BDD ordering/reduction are extra invariants. mk_and_correct requires well-formed state/operands and successful computation before concluding well-formed growth and semantic correctness. This is a useful monotonic-allocation antecedent, not a proof of our list algorithm, JSON/Python adapter or cryptographic hash properties.

intended_incremental_algorithm.status: TASK_CONTRACT_REVIEW_ONLY; IncrementalDictionary source not present at final observation
intended_incremental_algorithm.definition: expanded = d ++ dedup(filter(payload not in d, tail.map snd)); references = old.references ++ tail.map(fun (key,payload) => (key, expanded.idxOf payload)).
required_assumptions: DecidableEq Payload for exact membership, deduplication and index formation.
Valid old: each old referenced index is strictly below old.dictionary.length, to preserve all old optional lookups under dictionary growth.
old.dictionary.Nodup is an additional premise only if duplicate-free expanded dictionary is claimed; Valid alone does not imply dictionary uniqueness.
preservation_targets: Old dictionary is a literal prefix of expanded dictionary.
All old references remain an ordered prefix; repeated source keys and payload occurrences survive.
Every appended payload occurs in expanded dictionary; new references are in bounds.
Under Valid old, unpack(appendEntries old tail) = (unpack old).map(fun rows => rows ++ tail).
For old = pack oldRows, full decode specializes to some(oldRows ++ tail) using the existing exact round-trip theorem.
intended_incremental_algorithm.clarification: Valid is sufficient and cannot be dropped from the universal decoder-extension law for this algorithm. It is not asserted to be necessary for every individual input; some invalid inputs can remain invalid.

malformed_slot_repair_counterexample.reason: A dictionary prefix preserves successful old lookups, but growth may turn an old absent lookup into a value. Without Valid old the old decoder failure can be repaired, falsifying the intended universal equality.
